meta_description: Claire's Painting & Decorating transforms homes across Sheffield with expert interior and exterior painting. Free quotes, fully insured. Call today.
hero_subhead: From tired walls to beautiful rooms. We handle everything from feature walls to full house repaints with precision and care.
services_heading: Interior & Exterior Painting Services Across Sheffield
services_subhead: Whether it's a single room refresh or a full house transformation, we deliver flawless finishes every time.

services.title: Interior Painting
services.desc: Whole rooms, hallways, kitchens and bathrooms painted to perfection. We prep walls properly, use premium paints, and protect your furniture throughout.

services.title: Exterior Painting & Cladding
services.desc: Front doors, fascias, soffits and weathered woodwork restored. We work around weather and use trade-grade paints that last years longer.

services.title: Feature Walls & Accent Colours
services.desc: Bold colour choices need confident hands. We'll help you choose and execute a stunning focal point that transforms your space.

services.title: Wallpaper Hanging & Removal
services.desc: Expertly hung wallpaper or old paper stripped cleanly. We measure twice, cut once, and leave walls ready for any finish.

services.title: Ceiling & Woodwork Painting
services.desc: High ceilings, cornicing, skirting boards and doors deserve skilled attention. We reach corners you can't and finish them flawlessly.

services.title: Commercial Repaints
services.desc: Offices, retail units and rental properties refreshed quickly and professionally. We work flexibly around your schedule and minimise disruption.

about_pullquote: Great decoration changes how a home feels. I never rush it.
about_para_1: Claire's Painting & Decorating has been transforming homes across Sheffield and Rotherham for over 12 years. What started as one person with a brush and a van has grown into a trusted local name, built on repeat business and word-of-mouth referrals. We're fully insured, take pride in every job, and treat your home as carefully as our own.
about_para_2: Customers come back to us because we listen, we're tidy, and we deliver exactly what we promise. There are no surprises—you get a free quote upfront, honest timescales, and a finished room you'll actually love. Many of our jobs come from recommendations; that's the best compliment we can ask for.
reviews_heading: What Sheffield Homeowners Say About Claire

reviews.text: Claire came recommended by a neighbour and I'm so glad she did. We wanted our lounge completely redecorated—new colour, wallpaper in the alcove, all the woodwork. She was professional from the quote through to the final day. The room looks stunning and her team left everything spotless. Worth every penny.
reviews.author: Margaret T.

reviews.text: Had the whole house done while we were away for work. Claire managed the project brilliantly, kept us updated with photos, and the finish is really high quality. The prep work she does shows in how smooth and perfect everything looks. Would definitely hire her again.
reviews.author: David K.

reviews.text: We're renting the property out and needed it redecorated fast. Claire turned it around in two weeks, stayed on budget, and it looks like new. She's reliable, professional, and doesn't fuss—just gets the job done properly. Highly recommend.
reviews.author: Nicola P.
